items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A Cmd+K command palette in your shadcn/ui theme, run by cmdk-engine and rendered with cmdk: fuzzy search with synonyms, permissions, recent commands, nested commands and async sources.
items.docs: Render <CommandPalette /> once inside <CommandEngineProvider> from cmdk-engine/react, and register commands with useCommandRegister. Cmd+K or Ctrl+K opens it. In a Next.js App Router project, put the provider in a 'use client' file. Docs: https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/shadcn

items.name: command-palette-base-ui
items.title: Command Palette (Base UI)
items.description: The same Cmd+K command palette rendered with Base UI's Autocomplete and Dialog instead of cmdk.
items.docs: Render <CommandPalette /> once inside <CommandEngineProvider> from cmdk-engine/react, and give your app's root element `isolation: isolate` so the dialog stays on top. Cmd+K or Ctrl+K opens it. Docs: https://priyans-hu.github.io/cmdk-engine/docs/shadcn
